lines.text: Many learners say: I don't know where is the station.
Better: I don't know where the station is.
After I don't know, no question order.
The bank is! I don't know where the bank is.

data.wrong: I don't know where is the station.
data.right: I don't know where the station is.
data.why: After I don't know, no question order.
data.memory: I don't know where it is.

native.tip: Kita biasa bertanya ‘Where is the station?’ Karena itu, urutan ini terbawa. Setelah I don't know, pakai where + kata benda + is.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I don't know where is the station.” 😅 Setelah I don't know, urutannya where + benda + is: “I don't know where the station is.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawabannya: “The bank is.” Sekarang giliranmu! Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I don't know where the station is.” Lalu tulis satu kalimat dengan I don't know where. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We often ask ‘Where is the station?’ So we keep that order. After I don't know, use where + thing + is.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I don't know where is the station.” 😅 After I don't know, the order is where + thing + is: “I don't know where the station is.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
